name: demo-corpus-retrieval
note: Queries judged by hand against the fifteen documents in the bundled demo corpus. Relevance is binary and generous: a document is relevant if a researcher asking this question would want to have seen it. Judgements are recorded by corpus id (A1, N3, P2) so they survive renumbering of the store.
